values.note: Both RV site types are 30/50-amp full-hookup pull-throughs: $72.89 a night before tax for a June weeknight and for Saturday July 3, 2027; $69.89 for a January 2027 weeknight. 'KOA Select My Site' is +$20 optional. Up to 4 or 6 people by site type.

note: KOA Journey at 200 N Cedar Avenue, a few blocks from downtown Montrose; also cabins and tent sites. Pool and hot tub open Memorial Day to Labor Day. --Claude
summary: KOA's own pages + booking form: confirmed $72.89 in-season (June weeknight and July 3 Saturday, 23-ft motorhome), 50-amp full hookups, pull-throughs, phone 970-249-9177, pin (OSM camp_site at 200 N Cedar). Fees 72.89/72.89 -> 69.89/72.89 (January $69.89); added max length 75 ft, laundry/wifi/store, year-round, booking URL; hookups/sites/booking now confirmed on the operator's pages. Discounts (Good Sam directory) left alone: the KOA pages state none. Note: dropped the price/RV Life/hookup restatements.
flags: Price gate: $72.89 in season is over US$50, but Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP is 17 km away (gateways.py), so the gateway exception covers it. The family has not stayed here.
